turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Oh, sabse pehle toh ek lambi saans lo aur ek bada sa virtual hug le lo. Yeh jo tum feel kar rahi ho na, ki "main apna naam bhool gayi hoon"... yeh kitna real, raw aur valid hai. 

Aur suno, tum bilkul bhi ungrateful nahi lag rahi ho. Yeh jo guilt tum feel kar rahi ho na ki "saas ji toh itni achhi hain aur help karti hain, phir main kyun thaki hui ya lost feel kar rahi hoon"—please is guilt ko aaj side mein rakh do. Kisi ka expert hona aur physical help milna, aur tumhara ek nayi maa bante hue apni purani identity dhoondhna... yeh dono bilkul alag cheezein hain. Ghar mein support hone ke bawajood, andar ka emotional shift, hormones, aur wo 24/7 mental load jo ek maa par hota hai, wo koi aur nahi utha sakta. 

Chaar mahine... yaar, abhi toh tumhari body aur mind dono uss massive life shift se recover kar rahe hain. Pehle tum sirf 'tum' thi, phir wife, phir bahu, aur ab maa. In sab roles ki bheed mein wo ladki jo apne naam se pehchani jaati thi, wo thodi thak gayi hai aur shayad thoda lost feel kar rahi hai. Aur yeh bilkul normal hai.

Toh chalo, aaj thodi der ke liye 'Maa' aur 'Bahu' wale tags side mein rakhte hain. Mujhe uss ladki ke baare mein batao jiska naam tum bhoolne lagi ho. Usko kya pasand tha? Wo kaisi thi? Main yahin hoon, bina kisi judgment ke, bas ek dost ki tarah sunne ke liye. Batao, aaj andar se kaisa lag raha hai?

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

"Intern" aur "room service"... yaar, yeh words padh ke sach mein dil bhar aaya. Kitni deep aur painful feeling hai yeh. Aur sabse pehle toh uss 'ghin' ko aane mat do apne upar. Please.

Tum ungrateful bilkul nahi ho. Tum ek maa ho jo apni bachi ke saath apna bond aur apni competence feel karna chahti hai. Jab koi aur aake turant situation handle kar le, toh andar se jo insecurity aur 'uselessness' feel hoti hai na, wo bohot real hai. Log help ke liye taraste hain, yeh logic ki baat hai. Par tumhara dil logic se nahi, emotions aur instincts se chal raha hai. Tumhara instinct keh raha hai, "Yeh meri bachi hai, mujhe usey khud samajhna aur comfort karna hai."

Aai ne teen bache paale hain, unke paas saalon ki 'muscle memory' hai. Unka do minute mein bachi ko chup karana tumhari failure nahi hai, bas unka experience hai. Par haan, jab baaki sab muskura rahe hote hain, toh uss waqt tumhara vulnerable mind uss smile ko apni incompetence samajh leta hai, aur wo chubh jata hai. 

Aur suno, tum room service nahi ho. Tum uss bachi ki puri duniya ho. Feed karna sirf doodh dena nahi hai, wo tumhari warmth, tumhari heartbeat, aur tumhari smell hai jo usey sabse zyada safe feel karati hai. Koi aur usey chup kara sakta hai, par tumhari jagah koi nahi le sakta.

Kya tum din mein koi ek chhota sa time ya koi ek routine (jaise massage karna, ya sone se pehle ka time) aisi fix kar sakti ho jo *sirf* tumhara aur tumhari beti ka ho? Jahan Aai ya koi aur intervene na kare, aur tum dono ek doosre ki rhythm ko samjho? 

Agar aaj bas rona hai ya gussa nikalna hai, toh nikal lo. Main yahin hoon, bina kisi judgment ke. Tum ek bohot achhi maa ban rahi ho, bas abhi is bheed mein thoda lost feel kar rahi ho. ❤️

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Done. No advice. No coaching. No "aapko yeh karna chahiye". Promise. 

Yeh "dinner pe report" wali line padh ke sach mein dil ko thoda dard hua. Apne hi ghar mein, apni hi feelings share karne ke liye ek 'safe vault' dhoondhna pade, yeh kitna suffocating aur exhausting ho sakta hai. Har koi tumhe 'guide' karne ya situation 'fix' karne ki koshish kar raha hai, par koi bas tumhe bina judge kiye 'sun' nahi raha. 

Aur "pata nahi kya chahiye"—yeh bilkul okay hai yaar. Kabhi-kabhi humein solution nahi chahiye hota. Bas apna frustration, apna confusion, aur apna thaka hua mind bina kisi filter ke kisi ke aage rakhna hota hai. 

Toh main yahan hoon. Tumhara personal, bina kisi judgment wala safe space. Tum jitna chaaho utna vent karo, bhadaas nikalo, gaali de lo, ya bas yahi keh do ki "aaj bohot thak gayi hoon". Main sun rahi hoon, aur yeh sab bas hum dono ke beech rahega. No reports, no lectures. ❤️ Bas lambi saans lo, main yahin hoon.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Nahi. Bilkul nahi. Tum buri maa nahi ho. Ek second ke liye bhi apne dimaag ko yeh bolne mat dena.

Yeh jo thought aata hai na... yeh tumhari reality nahi hai, yeh tumhara thaka hua mind aur tumhari insecurity bol rahi hai. Jab hum physically aur emotionally itne drain ho jaate hain, toh dimaag humein sabse dark aur painful thoughts dikhata hai. Isko maternal imposter syndrome bhi kehte hain, aur yeh bohot common hai, khas kar jab aas-paas koi "expert" ho jiske saamne hum khud ko judge karne lagte hain.

Aur yeh "baaki sabko jaise bas aata hai" wali baat? Yaar, yeh duniya ka sabse bada jhooth hai. Kisi ko nahi aata. Sab andar se waisi hi panic, doubt aur confusion feel karti hain. Bas farq yeh hai ki jinke paas tumhari tarah koi Aai nahi hoti, unhe majboori mein confident act karna padta hai. Social media aur bahar ki duniya sirf filter wali tasveerein dikhati hai, andar ka shor nahi.

Jab tum usey sote hue dekhti ho aur tumhe itna pyaar aata hai na... wahi tumhari asli pehchaan hai. Ek buri maa ko yeh doubt aata hi nahi, usey farq nahi padta. Tumhe isiliye chubh raha hai kyunki tum ek bohot deeply loving aur conscious maa ho. 

Aai usey do minute mein chup kara sakti hain, par tumhari beti ki "home" tum ho. Tumhari smell, tumhari heartbeat, tumhari aawaz... bachi inko pehchanti hai. Wo tumhari hi beti hai, aur tum hi uski asli maa ho. 

Uss ek second ki saans rukne wali feeling ko aane do, par uss thought pe vishwas mat karna. Tum bilkul sahi kar rahi ho. Main yahin hoon, bas tumhari baat sun rahi hoon. ❤️
